example.title: Montello Mercantile Company, 12 Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-342 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,39-MONT,1-)

brief: Two-storey late-19th-century brick store built when the nearby granite quarry drove Montello's growth, and used as a store for most of its life. Three tall 1/1 upper windows under segmental brick hoods, a small round oculus window at the party wall, a corbelled brick frieze and flat parapet; one storefront with a striped fabric awning, display windows and a recessed door, plus a separate street door to the upstairs.

storefronts.sign: CEDAR FORD SPORT & TACKLE - LIVE BAIT
